name: H3 style anchors
markdown:
# H3 style anchors

> From the author's earlier studio, cleaned for publication: private paths, ports and some lines were removed, so a step may read short and a screen it names may not exist here. Status in this studio: Tested on the author's old stack.

What they all do: a one-line **purpose**; a first sentence that says who, where, the one thing that happens and how it ends (the builder copies it as the summary); **four beats** inside ONE take (0-1 s hook, 1-2.5 s build, 2.5-4 s payoff, 4-5 s button) with the camera's place and reason in the beat that needs it; no cut language; no `<d>` tag in the body; 136-147 words (budget for 5 s: 100-170); the lint scores them 0% filler (they were written to pass it, so that number proves the lint accepts them, not that the style is good).

## 1. Talking intro (case p1_talk, line by the builder)
Purpose: an intro that makes a stranger want to follow within 5 seconds

A chest-up phone shot of <Subject 1> greeting her followers from a bright room: she waves, welcomes them, leans toward the lens and finishes on a held smile. She stands in front of a plain pale wall with window light from the left. 0-1 s: <Subject 1> looks straight into the lens, lifts her right hand in a quick wave and starts speaking at once; the frame stays locked-off so the lips read clearly. 1-2.5 s: she turns the wave into an open palm held out to the viewer while she keeps speaking, her eyes on the lens. 2.5-4 s: on her last words she leans toward the lens and her smile widens, so her face fills more of the frame. 4-5 s: her mouth closes, her hand drops, she gives one small nod and holds the smile at the lens.

Soundscape: Quiet room tone under her voice; a brief brush of her sleeve as the hand lifts.
Music: N/A
Built line (added by the studio, never by the writer): `<Subject 1> (S1), in a warm friendly voice, says: <d>[English] Hi, welcome to my channel, I'm so glad you're here.</d>`

## 2. Walk toward the camera, outfit check (case p2_walk)
Purpose: an outfit check where the viewer sees the whole look in motion, then the face

A full-body phone shot of <Subject 1> in a casual summer outfit walking straight toward the camera down a sunny city street, with the camera backing away in front of her, ending with her stopping a step from the lens. Shops and passers-by line the sidewalk behind her. 0-1 s: <Subject 1> starts walking from about five metres away, head to toe in frame, arms swinging, her eyes on the lens. 1-2.5 s: she keeps her pace as the camera backs away at the same speed, so the whole outfit stays in frame while she passes a shop window. 2.5-4 s: the camera tightens from full-body to waist-up as she closes the distance, and she grins at the lens. 4-5 s: she stops one step from the camera, tilts her head and gives a small wave.

Soundscape: Her sandals on the pavement in a steady rhythm that stops on her last step; a low street murmur beneath.
Music: N/A

## 3. Pouring coffee in a kitchen (case p3_coffee)
Purpose: a pour that ends on the first sip, so the viewer sees the coffee made and enjoyed

A close handheld phone shot of <Subject 1> in a bright kitchen pouring coffee from a glass pot into a white mug, then lifting the mug for her first sip and smiling at the camera. The counter is white marble and the light comes from a window on the left. 0-1 s: the frame starts on her hands as <Subject 1> tilts the glass pot over the mug and a dark stream of coffee begins to fall. 1-2.5 s: the mug fills to just below the rim, she tips the pot upright and sets it on the counter with a clink. 2.5-4 s: she lifts the mug in both hands and the camera tilts up with it to her face; she sips, steam rising past her cheek. 4-5 s: she lowers the mug to her chin, smiles at the lens and the frame holds on the smile.

Soundscape: The coffee splashing into the mug, a clink as the pot meets the marble, then a short sip.
Music: N/A

## 4. Living-room dance sway (case p4_dance)
Purpose: a feel-good dance moment that builds from a sway to one bigger move and lands on a laugh

A full-body shot of <Subject 1> dancing to music in a cosy living room, starting with an easy sway, building to a slow turn and ending with a laugh. A beige sofa and a wooden floor fill the room behind her. 0-1 s: <Subject 1> begins to sway, shifting her weight from the right foot to the left in time with the beat. 1-2.5 s: she lifts both arms to shoulder height and adds a step to the left, her smile growing. 2.5-4 s: she raises one arm over her head and turns slowly on the spot until she faces the camera again. 4-5 s: she lands the last step on the beat, laughs and lets her arms drop. The camera stays locked-off from far back so the whole body and the sofa stay in frame.

Soundscape: Her bare feet on the wooden floor with each step; the tune of the music from a speaker in the room.
Music: A mellow upbeat pop groove at about 100 bpm with a soft bass and a steady beat.

## Notes for the next editor
* The words hook / build / payoff / button are the writer's planning labels; they must not appear in a prompt body (a test checks the anchors).
* The body never contains a `<d>` tag or a spoken line: the builder writes it, and `enhance.dialogue_problem` rejects a draft that does.
* To change an anchor, change `purpose_anchors.json` and this page together (a test compares them), then re-run `tests/studio/test_writer_purpose.py`.
